notes.title: 『MOMO Crash』 Demo v1.5.0 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45132154/7c6b0a8d9d872a127b8de8a320373fcc88edb0f1.png"]Hello to all our users! We are the "MOMO Crash" development team, working hard to spread the love of thighs to the world.

Fortunately for everyone who is still enjoying the demo, we're happy to announce that the demo will remain public for a while longer!

With this demo extension, we have now rolled out the Demo v1.5.0 update.✨

This includes the most-requested "Pause Function," so please check the details below for all the changes!



■ Added a "Pause Function" during gameplay.

　・During a song, press "Esc" on the keyboard or the "Start/Menu" button on your controller to pause the game.

　・While paused, you can choose to "Resume," "Retry" (restart the song from the beginning), or "Quit" (move to the end-game screen).

　・Please note that in the demo version, selecting "Quit" will take you to the final wishlist promotion screen.



■ After finishing the tutorial, you will now be sent to the song selection screen.

　・This means you will no longer be taken to the wishlist screen after completing the tutorial.

　・You can now continue to play other songs right after the tutorial.

　・Please note that after finishing any song other than the tutorial, you will be taken to the wishlist screen as before.

　・Please note that if you quit during the tutorial using the pause menu, you will be taken to the wishlist screen.



■ Title Screen

　・The "RECORDS" and "GALLERY" menu options, which were previously inaccessible, have been removed from the demo version. Please look forward to them in the full release!



■ Bug Fixes

　・Fixed an issue where the high score would not update and was overwritten by the latest score.

　・Fixed an issue where Seika's facial expression changes based on score were not being displayed correctly.

　・Improved the language selection feature in the options menu.



We will continue to listen to our players' valuable feedback and strive to create an even more enjoyable Thigh Paradise.

Thank you so much for always enjoying our demo! We look forward to your continued interest and feedback.



The "MOMO Crash" Development Team

SKOOTA GAMES / SCOOTER FILMS.INC

notes.title: 『MOMO Crash』 Demo v1.1.0 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45132154/7c6b0a8d9d872a127b8de8a320373fcc88edb0f1.png
Hello, Users! We are the 『MOMO Crash』 Development Team, dedicated to spreading the love for thighs throughout the world.
Are you enjoying the current demo version? Ahead of the Steam Next Fest, we've released the Demo v1.1.0 update to provide an even more enjoyable play experience!
Please check below for detailed changes!

■ New Thigh Warriors "SEIKA" & "HIKARU" Now Playable!
1. You can play all three existing songs with them right away, including their tutorials!

■ Main Gameplay
1. Adjusted the judgment timing for some notes to make playing more comfortable. The window for a "Perfect" judgment is now slightly wider.
2. Fixed a thigh animation error that occurred when the "Grip" and "Kick" buttons were pressed simultaneously.
3. Fixed an issue where Kitty Notes would not be judged correctly (or would react unintentionally) if the "Grip" button ([Z] key) was being held down.(Explanation: Kitty Notes require a separate long press of the [Z] key. This fix prevents Kitty Notes from misbehaving if the [Z] key is already held down for a "Grip" action.)
4. Revised some guide texts in the tutorial for greater clarity.

■ Title Screen
1. Reduced instances where the cursor could unintentionally move to the "EXIT" button.

■ Result Screen
1. Fixed an issue so that the difficulty indication is no longer displayed on the tutorial result screen.

We will continue to listen carefully to your valuable feedback and strive to create an even more fun Thigh Paradise.
Thank you for always enjoying the demo version! We look forward to your continued interest and feedback.

Sincerely,
The 『MOMO Crash』 Development Team
SKOOTA GAMES / SCOOTER FILMS.INC
